text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I lost to Tamamo...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! Tamamo Cross is so fast!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I knew Tamamo Cross was strong! Her
talent just
exploded in this race!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
City did great too! Have you ever seen
such a
stunning runner?! I hope she'll
give us more eye
candy on the track
next year!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So Tamamo gets all the normal praise,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Must be nice... I'm jealous.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I was strong too, wasn't I? I've earned my
share of
legitimate results, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why did I even bother?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's all been a big waste of time.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey! What's da big idea?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Weren't ya listenin' when I said don't
half-ass it
out dere?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I didn't. Or what, did you see me trying
to lose?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dat's not what I mean and ya know it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Tch... Fine! Be a little crybaby, then!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought ya wanted to show
everyone
ya got backbone!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Guess I'll ask ya one more time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What're ya racing for?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why do ya run?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Don't look down! Look me in da eyes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Unreal. Don't tell me I got my hopes up
for dis...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I thought you were better than dat.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Why couldn't I say anything?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh well... who cares? Not like any of it
even
matters.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm done.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: There's no point to running anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
People will always look at me the same,
no matter
how well I do.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I thought things would change if I
showed them
my ability. That's why I
worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But it was all just wishful thinking.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
People only care about "Pretty City." My
running
means nothing to them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All my effort until now has been
pointless. And it
will keep being
pointless.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So I... just don't care anymore.

Gold City looks defeated. Maybe having
her
compete in the Arima Kinen was a
bad idea.

But there's one thing I need to confirm
before I
let regret take over.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: じゃあ、走るのをやめる？
choice_data_list_en: Then do you want to stop running?

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't say anything. But that
silence is all I
need to hear.

She's just not at her best right now. All I
can do is
continue preparing her for the
road ahead.
choice_data_list: （シチーは諦めたいわけじゃない！）
choice_data_list_en: (It's not that City wants to give up!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm getting changed. Leave, please.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: その前に次のレースを決めるぞ
その前に次のレースを決めるよ
choice_data_list_en: Before that, let's decide on the next race.
Before that, we're deciding on your next race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I just say there's no point to
running
anymore?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're not listening.
choice_data_list: 春シニア三冠を目指したい
choice_data_list_en: I want to aim for the Spring Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 実力を証明し続けよう！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine... Knock yourself out. Not like
you need
me there for the sign-up
process.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you want to make me run so bad, then
go
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're actually doing this?
choice_data_list: じゃあ、まずは『大阪杯』だな！
じゃあ、まずは『大阪杯』だね！
choice_data_list_en: Then first up is the Osaka Hai!
Then first up is the Osaka Hai, right!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whatever... just get out so I can get
changed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I said get out!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What gives? Didn't I say there's no
point?
